b.x: A law is not a spell. It does not replace the fact that is in the room. Expanding consciousness is seeing the sentence as a sentence and the step as yours. It is not denying the world. It is taking part in it on purpose.
The initiate does not dress in mystery

Initiate, here, is not a title and not a group secret. It is the man who stopped being pushed by his own mind. The seven laws are the map the hermetic line handed down for that. Mentalism, correspondence, vibration, polarity, rhythm, cause and effect, gender. Seven names. One work: consciousness stops being a visitor and becomes the place you look from. The gray man was already practicing this without the name. Not exposing himself. Not narrating. Not living in fear. The laws explain why this is not only prudence. It is participation. The mind is not a closed room inside the head. It is the field where the step is born. Whoever understands this does not become more clever for others. He becomes harder to drag.
Mentalism. The universe is mental

The first law: the All is Mind. What you call the world reaches you through consciousness. This does not erase the door, the water, and the child. It says something else, higher. Interpretation is already creation. Two men on the same street are not on the same street. One sees an exit. The other sees a sentence. The sentence you contemplate organizes what the eyes agree to see. That is why the gray man does not feed the theater. Contemplating the end, all day, is asking the mind to build the end with the bricks it has: attention, speech, omission, the step that was not taken. Expanding consciousness, in this law, is going up one floor: you notice that you are thinking, and the thought stops being the ground. You remain in the world. You are no longer the world the sentence invented. The gray man's mentalism is sober. It is not 'I imagine and matter obeys now'. It is 'the mind commands the filter, the filter commands the act, the act enters the cause'. Whoever jumps straight to the miracle has not yet been initiated. Initiated is the one who holds the filter.
Correspondence. As above, so below

The second law: what is above is as what is below. The inner and the outer correspond. Not as punishment. As a mirror of degree. A house tight with rumor usually has a man tight with a sentence. A street read as threat all day corresponds to an attention that only accepts threat. Change the inner and the outer does not become another planet in the same minute. What you can see, say, and choose changes. That is enough for the step to be born different. The gray man uses the law in both directions. He looks at the room to read his own state: if everything became an enemy, the filter fell. He looks at his own state so as not to lie to the room: if the sentence is catastrophe and the room is ordinary, do not promote the sentence. As above, so below also holds for consciousness. A small thought makes a small world. A thought that can hold the fact and still hold calm makes a world in which the step exists. Expansion is that widening. It is not an escape into a sky. It is the same ground, seen from a floor that is not glued to fear.
Vibration. Nothing stands still

The third law: nothing rests. Everything moves. Everything vibrates. Thought, feeling, and matter are degrees of the same motion, not separate countries. Fear is a dense vibration. It contracts attention, closes the chest, shortens time until only the worst remains. Gratitude, presence, quiet joy are higher degrees. They open. They are not the ornament of a weak man. They are the state from which expanded consciousness sees more than one exit. The gray man does not stay in fear because fear is low and copies itself. Whoever vibrates all day in catastrophe only meets proofs of catastrophe. It is not a punishment from the universe. It is resonance. Rising is not a forced smile. It is refusing to live in the low degree once the fact has been seen. You saw it. You took the step the fact asked. Then you release the vibration of the rehearsal. Staying in the rehearsal is choosing the dense degree as home. The law does not order you to deny the weight. It orders you not to marry it.
Polarity. Opposites are degrees

The fourth law: everything is dual. Opposites are the same thing in different degrees. Fear and courage. Hatred and firmness. Scarcity and enough. They are not two worlds. They are two points on one rod. The gray man does not try to jump from one extreme to the other with a sentence. He rises by degrees. From panic to caution. From caution to presence. From presence to choice. Each degree is still the same rod, higher. That is why arguing with fear as if it were an enemy from outside fails. You are on the same axis. To transmute is to know the degree you are in and to move a little, on purpose. The initiate calls this the alchemy of the mind. On the gray man's ground it is simple: I do not ask myself to become another man by noon. I ask for one degree above this sentence. The expansion of consciousness is that climb, degree by degree. Whoever demands the top now falls into theater. Whoever rises one degree has already changed the universe he can inhabit.
Rhythm. The pendulum returns

The fifth law: everything has a flow and a return. The pendulum goes and comes back. The high day comes down. The low day is not the permanent address. The error is to nail identity to the point of the swing. 'I am the man who is finished' is the pendulum mistaken for the wall. The initiated gray man knows the rhythm and does not board it whole. When the swing goes down, he does not narrate the descent as destiny. He does the little the degree allows: water, silence, sleep, the small step. When the swing goes up, he does not become a stage. The rise passes too. Expanded consciousness, in this law, is not being the pendulum. It is the axis. The axis feels the motion and does not leave its place for each extreme. This is not coldness. It is measure. Whoever does not know the rhythm takes each low as final proof and each high as permission to expose himself. Both are visits. The house is the axis.
Cause and effect. You are a cause too

The sixth law: every cause has an effect. Every effect has a cause. Nothing is loose. The gray man stops seeing himself only as the effect of the government, the street, childhood, the rumor. That happened. It is the effect of causes you did not all choose. The law does not stop there. In this instant you are a cause. The spoken word is a cause. The chosen silence is a cause. The rehearsal that does not close is a cause. The early step is a cause. Ordinary consciousness lies down in the effect and tells the story of how the world did this to it. Expanded consciousness asks: which cause can I release now, from this chair. One. Not the whole universe. The hermetic law is not a court. It is a sequence. Whoever understands the sequence stops begging the effect to change on its own. He changes the cause that is in his hand: the contemplated sentence, the verb that was about to leave, the degree of the vibration, the step. The rest of the sequence obeys what was planted, not the speech.
Gender. The two forces in you

The seventh law: gender is in everything. It is not a fight between man and woman. It is the creative pair, in every mind. One force directs, begins, cuts. The other receives, gestates, gives form. Without the first, nothing starts. Without the second, the start does not become a thing. The gray man tips easily to one side. Only directing: haste, order, the sentence that commands in the hall. Or only receiving: waiting, swallowing, calling patience what is a retreat without a step. The initiate holds both. The force that decides the next act, and the force that does not speak while the cause ripens. Creating a higher reality asks for both genders of the mind. Intention is the directing. Living with time, without pulling the plant up every hour, is the gestating. Expansion of consciousness is not being ashamed of either. Whoever only cuts lives at war with rhythm. Whoever only waits lives at war with cause. The gray man, in both forces, lets the thing be born and does not announce it.
The sentence that stays

Seven laws, one man. The mind filters the world. The inner and the outer correspond. Everything vibrates, and the degree you sustain copies itself. Opposites are degrees, and you rise one. The pendulum visits, the axis stays. You are a cause in what is in your hand. Both forces, directing and gestating, live in you. What you contemplate, you feed. What you feed, you become. The initiated gray man contemplates the step, the calm, and the small cause. Not the theater. Expanded consciousness is not knowing the names of the seven. It is living one degree above the sentence that arrived, and letting the universe answer the new cause, not the old speech.
